input:
CURRENT SCENE:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

ITEMS:

[I39] 【孟子】小的时候   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences

[I40] 所以他每天【老是】从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿   correction: 老是 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: redundant with 每天
  rule card (missing_or_unclear_subject, Grammar): State the Subj. when leaving it out would make it unclear who does the action. Restate the Subj. after a different Subj. or an inserted “narrator comment” before returning to the main story.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: Add <Subj.> because otherwise it is unclear who <action>; the previous <Subj./narrator comment> cannot continue here.  Her terms: Subj., narrator comment
  her past correction: 因为[+他]老是去墓地吃祭品
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 所以他和朋友坐墓地[-在]祭拜

[I41] 所以他每天老是从早到晚【去】墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿   correction: 去 → 在   strength: error
  checker's note: duration takes place at the cemetery
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 所以他和朋友坐墓地[-在]祭拜
  her past correction: 所以他和朋友坐[+在]墓地在祭拜

[I42] 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩【玩】儿   correction: 玩 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction: 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction: 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿

items.explanation: 孟子 appears for the first time, so please introduce him briefly, for example 孟子这个孩子.
It would be more natural to omit 老是 because 每天 already shows that this happens regularly.
墓地 is the location where the playing happens, so use 在+Place before the action.
It would be more natural to say 玩儿 here; 玩玩儿 is redundant.
